title: RiskCalculatorRequest
description: Request body for POST /api/risk. Sent by a client (CLI or other service) to the risk_calculator service.

company_name.description: Human-readable company name, forwarded to sentiment_analysis. Defaults to ticker if omitted.

lookback_days.description: Number of calendar days of historical daily price data to fetch.

benchmark.description: Benchmark ticker for beta and relative-risk calculations.

weights.description: Composite-score weights; should sum to ~1. Defaults to {market: 0.7, sentiment: 0.3}.

account_size.description: Optional account size in USD for position-sizing recommendation.

max_risk_pct.description: Max % of account to risk on this position (for stop-loss-based sizing).

sentiment_api_url.description: Override sentiment_analysis base URL (else SENTIMENT_API_URL env or http://localhost:8000).
